Yuu and Itsuki's MAF Primer - Enter the Instructor -
Itsuki: I'm Yamashiro, your tactics instructor from today. Glad to have you.
Yuu: Yes, Instructor!
Itsuki: Good answer.
Now, straight to it: what matters most to a pilot?
Yuu: Defeating the enemy?
Itsuki: That too, but what matters most is staying alive.
You can clear most stages as long as you don't get shot down.
Yuu: Understood, Instructor!
Itsuki: Good. From next time I'll teach you techniques for real combat.
First, play the tutorial and master the basic controls.
★Play the tutorial before you start a mission and you'll
  learn to fly a Valkyrie much more easily.
Next  -  Customizing  -

Yuu and Itsuki's MAF Primer - Customizing -
Itsuki: Well, everyone, got the basic controls down from the tutorial?
Yuu: Yes, Instructor!
Itsuki: Good attitude. The basics matter in everything.
So today, as a special lesson, I'll teach you the secrets of tuning.
Yuu: A special lesson? How lovely★
Itsuki: ...
There's a lot you can upgrade, but [y]beginners should start with HP.[/]
Raising Range, so missiles reach farther, or each weapon's power is good too.
Yuu: That's really helpful!
Itsuki: Good. Next time I'll explain each unit's traits and weapons.
★Clear a mission and you earn Tune Points.
  Use your Tune Points to keep making your unit stronger!
Next  -  Master Your Unit  -

Yuu and Itsuki's MAF Primer - Master Your Unit -
Itsuki: Straight to it, Akimizu: is there a unit you like in MAF?
Yuu: The Spartan!★
Itsuki: ...Well, it's certainly a fine unit, but you can't leave out
the biggest draw of every Macross series:
the Valkyrie variable fighter.
Yuu: It transforms into three modes: Fighter, GERWALK and Battroid, right?
Itsuki: Hm, you've done your homework.
Each of the three modes has its strengths. Switch between them well
and you should gain the upper hand in battle.
Between us: with the skill [o]"Circus Flight"[/], even units that
can't fly get a flight mode. Now you're set for air combat too!!
Yuu: No way! That's amazing, Instructor★
Itsuki: Next time is the last lesson. I've saved my best material for it.
Next  -  Offense Is the Best Defense  -

Yuu and Itsuki's MAF Primer - Offense Is the Best Defense -
Itsuki: This time I'll explain how to attack.
In MAF, whoever masters missiles masters the world...
Yuu: M-missiles?
Itsuki: That's right!! In range, homing, rounds fired, damage and more,
missiles are an extremely powerful way to attack.
Yuu: I like melee better, though.
Itsuki: Heh. For people like you, I've added the [o]"Melee Finish Bonus"[/].
Defeat an enemy with melee for an extra bonus. Do give it a try.
Yuu: Now that's DESTROY!!
Itsuki: And one more thing you mustn't forget: the [o]"Special Attack"[/]!!
It uses 3 blocks of the SP Gauge, but it's an extremely powerful attack.
And don't overlook that you're fully invincible while it's active.
Itsuki: Well, that ends our lessons. Any last questions?
Yuu: Um, er... Instructor, are your glasses just for show?
Itsuki: Heh, sorry. That's a secret.

Why You Should Play MAF Co-op
◆Versus (Free Battle, Force Battle)
- Battle your friends, up to 4 players.
- Bring the units you've each trained and fight the ultimate battle.
- Battle your friends and earn lots of Tune Points.
◆Co-op Missions
- You can play every Campaign mode mission together with friends.
- Even if it's hard alone, with friends at your side you can
  surely overcome any tough mission.
- Some super-hard missions can only be played in co-op,
  so take them on together★
◆ID Card Exchange
- Play co-op with friends and you swap ID cards automatically.
- Set your intro, title and icon, and show them off to everyone★
